title: Do’s und Don'ts
slide_intent: Contrast preferred and rejected movement because a similar final frame can hide very different reading experiences.
strategic_value: Explicit comparisons can keep DB motion clear and consistent across independently produced work.
demonstration: Four paired rows compare timing, effects, movement axes and animation order. The capture retains consent placeholders and the positive/negative captions; all eight films are available separately.
practical_value: Evaluate a proposed animation against timing, simplicity, axis and sequence before approving its final behavior.

content_islands.name: Timing pair
content_islands.spec: Compare appropriate timing with movements that are too fast or slow.

content_islands.name: Effects pair
content_islands.spec: Contrast few animated parameters with unnecessary effects.

content_islands.name: Axes pair
content_islands.spec: Keep clear-axis movement opposite the diagonal-motion prohibition.

content_islands.name: Sequence pair
content_islands.spec: End with structured order versus an overloaded, unclear build.

reference_purposes.Intent: The captions connect timing with decisiveness, few parameters with consistency, and structured sequences with orientation.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source excludes effects such as motion blur and states that diagonal animations without a clear axis are never used.
